commands.command: set -euo pipefail; EXPECTED=0d4325f08033a38e4fd3769c38b1572e344a27ff; git fetch -q origin mvp/environment-controller; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; test "$(git rev-parse origin/mvp/environment-controller)" = "$EXPECTED"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; git diff --check; echo STAGE28E_E_EXIT_EXACT_SHA_PASS=$EXPECTED

set -euo pipefail; test -f docs/STAGE28E_PHASE_E_HANDOFF.md; grep -Fq 'Phase E implementation and bounded hardware verification are complete' docs/STAGE28E_PHASE_E_HANDOFF.md; grep -Fq '223792 / 223260 / 180224 B' docs/STAGE28E_PHASE_E_HANDOFF.md; grep -Fq '+9892 B' docs/STAGE28E_PHASE_E_HANDOFF.md; grep -Fq 'Next phase: **Stage28E Phase F' docs/STAGE28E_PHASE_E_HANDOFF.md; grep -Fq 'E COMPLETE -> Phase F NEXT' docs/CURRENT_STATUS.md; grep -Fq 'Latest handoff: `docs/STAGE28E_PHASE_E_HANDOFF.md`' docs/CURRENT_STATUS.md; grep -Fq 'Latest handoff: `docs/STAGE28E_PHASE_E_HANDOFF.md`' docs/CONTINUATION_PLAN.md; grep -Fq 'Phase F — focused binary-arbiter continuity/regression proof' docs/CONTINUATION_PLAN.md; echo STAGE28E_E_EXIT_DOCS_PASS

set -euo pipefail; grep -Fq 'heap_caps_malloc(kQueueStorageBytes, MALLOC_CAP_SPIRAM | MALLOC_CAP_8BIT)' src/climate/storage/Stage27TelemetryLogger.cpp; grep -Fq 'taskStackBytes() noexcept { return 6144U; }' src/climate/storage/Stage27TelemetryLogger.h; grep -Fq 'CONFIG_ESP_MAIN_TASK_STACK_SIZE=12288' config/idf/sdkconfig.defaults.stage27c; grep -Fq '# CONFIG_SPIRAM_USE_MALLOC is not set' config/idf/sdkconfig.defaults.n8r8 || true; grep -Fq 'thermal trip `>=28 C`' docs/STAGE28E_PHASE_E_HANDOFF.md; grep -Fq 'recovery `<=26 C` continuously for 10 minutes' docs/STAGE28E_PHASE_E_HANDOFF.md; grep -Fq 'final fake-locked hardware policy' docs/STAGE28E_PHASE_E_HANDOFF.md; git diff --check; echo STAGE28E_E_EXIT_SAFETY_AND_SOURCE_PASS
set -euo pipefail; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; git diff --check; echo STAGE28E_E_EXIT_GATE_PASS
